title: 2027 Full Wood Kiln Rental
commitment: Full kiln load, fire, and unload managed by renting group
evidence_sentence: Groups can rent the full noborigama for dedicated firings on monthly scheduled dates in 2027.
evidence_quote: Those interested in renting the full kiln must have experience in loading and firing wood kilns.
how_to_join: Registration opens monthly; must have prior wood kiln loading/firing experience; at least one group member must be able to load confidently
summary: Full noborigama wood/salt kiln rental for experienced groups. Registration opens monthly; links go live on stated dates (e.g., Jan 5 at 10am for January dates). $2,250 per firing.
